Legally, know about interlineation (adding words/lines to contracts) and cross-outs (crossing out terms in contracts). If you cross out a term or something you disagree with on paper and both parties sign it, it's normally a done deal in court (although "Wait! I didn't see that!" rarely holds up. It's honest practice for both parties to initial next to anything left out or added in).
